write_failed: The file could not be saved
delete_tour_msg: “{0}” and all its results will be deleted.
restart_msg: The results are cleared and you can change the players and the format. Undo can bring them back.
fdesc_single: Lose once and you are out. Seeds follow the player order; byes fill the bracket when the count is not a power of two.
fdesc_round: Everyone plays everyone once. A win is 3 points, a draw 1; ties are broken by score difference.
fdesc_swiss: A few rounds where players with the same points meet and nobody meets twice. Ties are broken by the opponents' points (Buchholz).
not_backup: This is not a Bracket backup
next_round_hint: Round {0} of {1} is drawn when this round is complete.
no_draws: A knockout match needs a winner
no_tours_hint: Create one, add the players and press Start.
players_hint: Type a name and press Enter, or paste a list of names (one per line).
